title: Vehicle heart totem of undying
description: This resource pack changes the texture of te totem of undying to a heart one.
body:
# Vehicle Heart Totem of Undying
Give your Totem of Undying a unique, mount‑inspired makeover! This resource pack replaces the default totem with the Mob Riding HUD heart—the icon that appears when you ride a mob in Minecraft.

### Why download it?

- Authentic Minecraft Feel: Uses a real HUD element from the game, making it blend perfectly with vanilla aesthetics.
- Unique Survival Flair: A fun twist that makes your totem feel like your own personal “mount health” life-saver.
- Great for RPG or Medieval Themes: Fits perfectly in servers or worlds where horses and mounts play a big role.
- Lightweight & Compatible: Works smoothly with shaders and other texture packs without any conflicts.

Survive with the heart of a true rider!

## Terms of Use

You are free to use this resource pack in Minecraft, your videos, and your modpacks.

If you include it in a modpack or showcase it in a video, I would appreciate it if you add a link to this page in the description.

_**Do not redistribute or claim the pack as your own.**_
